residency_requirement: Indian resident; Surrogate Mother per Surrogacy Regulation Act 2021
sub_limits_waiting_notes: One-time 36-month policy with no renewal. Annual SI of INR 2L (or 3L) applies each of the 3 policy years. Only covers complications arising from surrogacy pregnancy and post-partum delivery of the surrogate mother. Initial 30-day waiting period not applicable for accidents.

inpatient_hospitalization.notes: Only for complications from surrogacy pregnancy and post-partum delivery; not the proposer

maternity_coverage.notes: Covers complications from surrogacy pregnancy and post-partum delivery of surrogate mother; not regular maternity

ambulance_cover.limit_text: Up to INR 2,000 per policy year

room_rent_capping: Single AC/Non-AC base single room category; proportionate deduction if higher category; no cap in PPN packaged procedure
icu_capping: 5% of annual SI per day; proportionate deduction for higher category; no cap in PPN

disease_wise_sub_limits.modern_treatments: Up to 25% of Annual SI (except IONM); subject to treatment-wise limits

permanent_exclusions: Rest Cure, Rehabilitation and Respite Care
Surrogacy related Expenses (other than complications covered)
temporary_exclusions: Initial 30 days for all illnesses (not applicable for accidents)
notable_exclusions_summary: Niche product: covers only complications during surrogacy pregnancy and post-partum delivery of the surrogate mother. Issued for surrogacy beneficiary by Intending Couple/Woman; non-renewable, 36-month single-shot policy.
claim_process_summary: Cashless via TPA - pre-auth 1 hour, final 3 hours. Reimbursement documents within 30 days of discharge. Claim decision in 15 days of last document.
